name: 29527 · Conway, SC
findings: ZIP 29527 (Conway) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29527 (Conway) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 29527 (Conway) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 41% of the typical level).
